title: SS27 Boys' Formalwear Styling
summary: Occasion boyswear: sailor-collar or linen shirt, tailored shorts, loafers or canvas shoes, for weddings and ceremonies.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Sailor collars, navy blues and nautical details appeared throughout Playtime Paris<sup>[1]</sup>
- Fatamadrina lists lightweight linen, voile, organic cotton, terry and micro-mesh as SS27 fabrics<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Sailor-collar shirt + navy shorts.**
- **Linen shirt + tailored Bermuda.**
- **Seersucker set.**

design_implications:
- Soft collars and linings; no scratchy interlining.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Time occasionwear for communion and wedding season.
